title: Blockchain vs. Bullshit: Thoughts on the Future of Money [Classic Bitcoin & Open Blockchain  Talk]
summary: Andreas Antonopoulos explains how to tell Bitcoin-style blockchains from corporate blockchain hype. He argues the goal should be de-banking everyone rather than banking the unbanked.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a corrective to enterprise blockchain marketing and as an explanation of what makes Bitcoin distinctive.
